site.name: Big Cameron Mine
overview: Big Cameron Mine is a documented historic tungsten property in Boulder County's tungsten district, preserved in state mining records and federal exploration files.

timeline.text: State mine records document development of the Big Cameron tungsten property within the Boulder County district.
Federal mineral-exploration records continued to preserve the Big Cameron property as a documented tungsten locality.

moreHistory: The mapped mine locality near 39.99194, -105.45417 is consistent with the retained state and federal records for Big Cameron. The location identifies the historic mine area without asserting that a surviving opening has been field-surveyed.

sourceReferences.title: Colorado Geological Survey MI-04 — Tungsten Mines of Colorado
